subject: Appointment availability
body: Hello, I missed your call earlier. Do you have a routine eye test available next week, preferably after 3pm?

subject: New glasses collection
body: Hi, could you confirm whether my new glasses are ready to collect? I can come in tomorrow afternoon.

subject: Contact lens order
body: Please can I order another three-month supply of my usual daily contact lenses?

subject: Child eye test question
body: My son has been complaining of headaches after school. Could we arrange an eye test this week?

subject: Prescription copy request
body: Would you be able to email me a copy of my latest spectacle prescription?

subject: Change appointment time
body: I am booked on Friday morning but now need a later appointment. Is anything available after 4pm?

subject: Dry eye advice follow-up
body: Thank you for the advice at my visit. Which eye drops did the optometrist recommend that I purchase?

subject: Broken frame repair
body: The arm on my glasses has snapped. Can I bring them in for a repair assessment?

subject: Recall reminder
body: I received a recall reminder. Please book me into the first Saturday appointment you have.

subject: Varifocal lens options
body: Could someone explain the difference between the standard and premium varifocal lenses before I order?

subject: Red eye appointment
body: My right eye has been red and uncomfortable since yesterday. Do I need an urgent appointment?

subject: Invoice request
body: Please send me an itemised receipt for the frames and lenses I bought this month.

subject: Update contact details
body: I have changed my mobile number. Please can you update my record when I next visit?

subject: Glaucoma monitoring booking
body: I am due for my pressure check. Are there appointments with Dr Amelia Reed next week?

subject: Sunglasses enquiry
body: Do you stock prescription sunglasses and can I use my current prescription?

subject: Cancel appointment
body: I need to cancel tomorrow’s appointment because I am unwell. I will rebook soon.

subject: Frame fitting adjustment
body: My new glasses keep slipping down. Could I come in for a quick adjustment?

subject: Contact lens check
body: I have started finding my monthly lenses uncomfortable by the evening. Can I book a review?

subject: Payment plan question
body: Can you tell me what payment options are available for premium varifocal lenses?

subject: Opening hours
body: Are you open late on Thursdays for collections?

subject: Your eye examination confirmation
body: Your routine eye examination is confirmed. Please bring your current glasses and a list of any medication.

subject: Your glasses are ready
body: Good news — your glasses have passed our checks and are ready to collect from the practice.

subject: Eye test recall reminder
body: Our records show that your routine eye examination is now due. Reply to this email or call us to arrange a convenient time.

subject: Contact lens collection
body: Your contact lens order has arrived and is ready to collect.

subject: Urgent appointment information
body: We have reserved an urgent appointment for you today. Please contact us if your symptoms worsen before the appointment.

subject: Receipt for your purchase
body: Attached would be your receipt in a production system. This demo message confirms payment for your recent optical purchase.

subject: Children’s eye examination reminder
body: This is a reminder for the children’s eye examination booked at Pingstar.

subject: Frame order update
body: Your selected frame has been ordered from our supplier. We expect it to arrive within five working days.

subject: Follow-up after your visit
body: Thank you for attending. Please contact the practice if the new prescription does not feel comfortable after the adaptation period.

subject: Appointment rescheduled
body: Your appointment has been moved to the new date and time discussed by phone.

subject: Draft: overdue recall follow-up
body: Hello, our records show that your eye examination is overdue. We would be pleased to arrange an appointment at a convenient time.

subject: Draft: product collection
body: Hello, your optical order is now ready for collection. Please let us know which day you plan to visit.

subject: Draft: clinical follow-up
body: Hello, we are following up after your recent appointment. Please reply if your symptoms have changed or worsened.
